subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a monk who believes proximity is the core of tactical engagement, and who recalls that the moment of holding a thing without deciding to let go is what brought him to the monastery.
source_quote: I am a monk. My entire tactical vocabulary is built around being adjacent to the problem. Range is something other people deal with. Range is Daz's whole personality. I hit things. I grapple things. I drag things into the air and then drop them from inconvenient heights. All of that requires proximity. And Ilvara's legendary reaction had, in one economical move, made proximity impossible.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is frightened by a targeted psychic fear effect that repeats the message 'you will not approach her' and prevents him from closing distance to Ilvara Mizzrym.
source_quote: The fear was immediate and specific and entirely unwanted. Not a general dread — not the crawling ambient horror of the Underdark that you learn to fold into background noise. This was targeted. This said: she is down there, and you will not approach her, and you will not approach her, and you will not approach her. Repeated. Insistent.

subject: heart fungus
fact: The heart fungus is a massive, pulsing, cavern-dominating fungal entity that is resistant to typical damage but doubly vulnerable to radiant damage.
source_quote: It's resistant to the usual stuff that funguses are resistant to, but if you hit it hard enough, it should die. It actually is doubly not resistant to radiant damage.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sword that does not wait politely in a scabbard and is immediately drawn when something obviously needs to be hit with radiant light.
source_quote: Dawnbringer was already in my hand. She'd been in my hand since we walked in. She's not the sort of sword that waits politely in a scabbard when there's something this obviously in need of being hit with radiant light.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who wants to walk up to the problem and apply Dawnbringer to it until the problem stops, and who chooses not to make an opportunity attack against Jorlan as he charges Ilvara.
source_quote: I've been in enough fights now to know the shape of a bottleneck. The cavern was doing most of Ilvara's work for her — keeping us spread out, keeping me in particular at range from the thing I wanted to hit. I am, in my heart, a dwarf who wants to walk up to the problem and apply Dawnbringer to it until the problem stops.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is a scarred drow warrior who breaks from position to charge Ilvara Mizzrym across an insect swarm, calling her name like a wound reopening.
source_quote: He broke from position and charged toward her across the swarm-infested terrain, and the name that came out of him was not a battle cry. 'ILVARA' It came out like a wound reopening. Not rage exactly — rage is clean, rage has direction. This was something uglier and more honest than rage.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a party member who immediately recognizes the threat to Glabbagool from the insect plague and asks 'Oh, how about Glabbagool?' before assessing his own safety.
source_quote: I felt the swarm before I saw it. A wall of noise, of biting, chittering fury... 'Oh, how about Glabbagool?' That was me. That was the question I asked first, before I assessed my own position, before I checked the tactical map for who was flanking whom.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a sentient gelatinous cube companion who survives twenty-six points of damage from the insect plague while attempting to participate in the fight.
source_quote: Twenty-six points of damage. The grey ooze took twenty-six points of damage from a spell he had nothing to do with, while he was hovering at the edge of the chaos doing his best to look like he was following the conversation.

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern is a vast, dark space dominated by the heart fungus, with difficult terrain between combatants and a fungal minion population of thirteen hit points.
source_quote: The Heart Fungus stood at the center of the cavern like something that thought it had time. Massive, pulsing, ringed with spore-choked air and difficult terrain between me and it — a whole careful geography of annoyance. Ilvara had retreated into its shadow, and everything that mattered in this fight was on the wrong side of a cave full of fungal servants and an insect swarm that hadn't arrived yet but was coming... all thirteen hit points of them, gone before they could do anything useful.

subject: Ilvara Mizzrym
fact: Ilvara Mizzrym is the high priestess of House Mizzrym, corrupted vessel of Zuggtmoy, who casts Insect Plague at the cavern entrance and triggers a psychic fear effect against Zalthir.
source_quote: Ilvara Mizzrym, high priestess of House Mizzrym, Zuggtmoy's beloved instrument, corrupted vessel of a demon lord of fungal nightmare — and I was going to annoy her. The eldritch tendrils of the tattoo were already unreeling from my arm before the words finished leaving my mouth. Then Ilvara cast Insect Plague.

subject: heart fungus destruction
fact: The heart fungus is destroyed in one round by Thorin’s Dawnbringer, which deals radiant damage, despite extensive preparation by the DM.
source_quote: I struck. And then struck again. The heart fungus wilted. One round. That was all it got. 'And so you kill it. So it wilts.' 'I do what I can.' 'I spent so much time creating this icon.'

subject: insect plague activation
fact: Ilvara Mizzrym casts Insect Plague at the cavern entrance, creating a swarm that instantly kills thirteen fungal minions and damages Glabbagool with twenty-six points of damage.
source_quote: Then Ilvara cast Insect Plague. The swarm hit the cavern entrance like a wall of sound and motion — a biblical chittering that shredded the fungal minions instantly, all thirteen hit points of them, gone before they could do anything useful. Twenty-six points of damage. The grey ooze took twenty-six points of damage...

subject: Jorlan's charge
fact: Jorlan breaks from combat to charge Ilvara Mizzrym across the insect swarm, prompting Thorin to forgo an opportunity attack and allow the confrontation to proceed.
source_quote: He broke from position and charged toward her across the swarm-infested terrain... I had an opportunity attack. I stood there with Dawnbringer in hand and thought about it... 'Alright, so 8 says I do the sensible thing. Which I guess is let them go and let the enemies... let the girls fight.' I stepped aside and let Jorlan pass.

subject: Revivify offer
fact: Grygum offers to use Revivify to restore one fallen minion, but clarifies that the fallen fungal servants belong to Ilvara, not the party.
source_quote: If anybody is too saddened by the loss of any of our minions, I do have a Revivify spell that I could use to bring one of them back. Someone shouted immediately. Not our minions. Her minions. The fallen fungal servants belonged to Ilvara, not to us. Of course they did.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes that the tides have turned in the conflict between Jorlan and Ilvara, and acknowledges the shift in power dynamics without intervening.
source_quote: Zalthir, deadpan as ever, offered the only appropriate summary: 'The tides have turned.'

subject: elevated walkway
fact: The elevated walkway is a raised platform in the cavern from which Thorin descends to engage the heart fungus directly.
source_quote: So I descended from the elevated walkway and pushed through the terrain toward the heart fungus...

subject: insect swarm
fact: The insect swarm is a magically conjured plague that fills the cavern, kills fungal minions, damages Glabbagool, and creates difficult terrain between combatants.
source_quote: The swarm hit the cavern entrance like a wall of sound and motion — a biblical chittering that shredded the fungal minions instantly... a wall of noise, of biting, chittering fury, the kind of sound that bypasses the thinking part of the brain and goes straight to the older, smaller part that just says run.

subject: heart fungus's final action
fact: The heart fungus, after being damaged by Thorin, delivers a final massive blow to Zalthir while he is frightened and unable to close distance, dealing unmitigated damage.
source_quote: And the heart fungus, which had apparently been paying attention, chose this moment to remind me that fifteen feet of reach is a very generous number when the thing reaching lives on the floor and I have been hovering at the ceiling being useless. It found me. The blow was enormous — the kind of damage that lands differently when you have no immediate recourse...

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced as the one who observed that the situation was 'accurately described' by Asha's characterization of Daz as an insane mage who had converted to Lolthism, with the steady, clear-eyed precision of a man keeping accurate records.
source_quote: Grygum, at some point in this sequence, observed that the situation was 'accurately described' by Asha's characterization of me as an insane mage who had converted to Lolthism. He meant it kindly. Or as kindly as Grygum observes anything, which is with the steady, clear-eyed precision of a man keeping accurate records.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place, and she was not prepared to surrender her claim to the Underdark promised by a demon lord without fully expressing her grievances.
source_quote: And then Ilvara was still standing. Still radiating darkness and spite and the unmistakable spiritual signature of someone who has been promised the Underdark by a demon lord and is not prepared to surrender that claim without fully expressing her grievances.

subject: fungal cavern
fact: The fungal cavern contains a bridge that cracked under Ilvara's weight, a poison cloud whose range the new Drow warriors entered, and a chittering wall of insect plague that engulfed the northeast passage.
source_quote: The bridge cracked under her. Thorin's work. She leapt clear anyway... Five drow warriors emerging from the cavern shadows. The insect bloom still hanging in the air... She was hauling me northeast through the chittering wall of it while the poisonous gas did its work on both of us.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard, who refused to hide or be extracted, choosing instead to stand in the smoke of his own fireball and participate in the fight, asserting that the best way for Nym to get paid was to prevent everyone from dying.
source_quote: I am not gonna leave. Everyone here... to fight for me without me also participating. I don't give a damn if you get paid. The best way for you to get paid, then, is to continue the fight and prevent all of us from dying.

subject: Nym Duskryn
fact: Nym Duskryn was sent with Kaelira to extract Daz, delivering a contractually bound professional frustration that culminated in her asking if she could kill his brother, and shifting from exasperated professionalism to pointed clarity when Daz rejected transactional logic.
source_quote: Can you please keep your head down and out of combat? We only get paid if you live... Can I kill your brother? He was always the dumber of the ones, and if I understood correctly, he's covered in fungus?

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira closed her hand around Daz's arm like a vice and hauled him northeast through the chittering wall of poison gas, enforcing her strong opinions about his survival without his consent.
source_quote: Then Kaelira's hand closed around my arm like a vice. 'Come with me if you want to live, you idiot.' I went. Not gracefully — she was hauling me northeast through the chittering wall of it while the poisonous gas did its work on both of us.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree, a Lolth-devotee, immediately identified the Duskryn sisters as traitors and demanded they be punished, but was overridden by Daz’s sustained Lolth-follower identity, which she accepted without question due to its consistent characterization.
source_quote: Who are you? You must be traitors! Traitors to Lolth!... 'No, these are friends of Lolth, and they're here to help.' The words came out smooth. No hesitation, no announcement, no explanation.

subject: Jorlan Duskryn
fact: Jorlan Duskryn was the dumber of the Duskryn siblings, covered in fungus, and was struck by a lightning bolt that sent him staggering across the cavern floor after Nym redirected her frustration toward him.
source_quote: He was always the dumber of the ones, and if I understood correctly, he's covered in fungus?... Jorlan Duskryn went staggering across the cavern floor, and Nym's professional frustrations had found their outlet.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir processed the question of unnamed creatures with his characteristic meditative calm, acknowledging '5 Drow' and calling it 'awesome.'
source_quote: Are there 3 more unnamed creatures?... '5 Dark Elves, it looks like? 5 Drow?' Zalthir processed this with his characteristic meditative calm. 'That's awesome.'

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is the sentient, gentle, luminously good-natured ooze companion who had taken twenty-six points of damage from Ilvara's plague and was still trying to participate in the ambient conversation of the battle.
source_quote: Glabbagool — our sentient, gentle, luminously good-natured ooze companion who had been, from what I could tell, simply trying to participate in the ambient conversation of the battle — had already taken twenty-six points of damage from Ilvara's plague and survived.

subject: T'sarran soldiers
fact: T'sarran soldiers, elite and armored, stood at the tunnel mouth debating whether to charge through an insect plague without Dispel Magic, stymied by petty logistical failure despite having the firepower and numbers.
source_quote: Elite drow soldiers. Trained. Armored. Standing at the threshold of a crisis they had presumably accepted a contract to resolve, now stymied by a wall of insects and a mage with insufficient spell preparation... 'I thought you said this was going to be an easy kill.' 'And you don't have a Dispel Magic.'

subject: Matron Mother of House T'sarran
fact: The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about the fireball incident in the fungal cavern, as the surviving mage warned before collapsing.
source_quote: The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about this.

subject: Fireball cast by Daz
fact: Daz cast a shaped Fireball arc around everything he wanted to preserve, excluding Glabbagool and others, while destroying the Drow warriors in the insect plague, leaving the mage barely standing.
source_quote: I cast Fireball in a shaped arc around everything I wanted to keep. The cavern went very bright for a moment. The Drow warriors who had been irritated about the Insect Plague were no longer irritated about the Insect Plague.

subject: Ilvara's eruption
fact: After being struck by a guiding bolt, Ilvara erupted into a cloud of poisonous spores, not simply falling but expelling biology transformed by her pact with a fungal demon lord, leaving only spores where a woman had been.
source_quote: She *erupted*. A cloud of poisonous spores, billowing outward from what had been a person. A woman who had traded herself to a fungal demon lord, and what was left was biology, not identity. Not even a body. Just spores.

subject: tunnel mouth
fact: The tunnel mouth was the site of a profoundly unhelpful argument among T'sarran soldiers, who lacked Dispel Magic and were debating whether to charge through an insect plague while a 4th-level fireball was introduced into the conversation.
source_quote: There's a category of failure I find almost aesthetically interesting — not the grand collapse, but the petty logistical one. They had the firepower. They had the numbers. What they did not have was Dispel Magic, and so they stood in the tunnel debating whether to charge while a 4th-level fireball was introduced into the conversation.

subject: shield ward
fact: Daz's shield ward activated as a reaction before he consciously decided to cast it, deflecting a bolt that would have found his ribs.
source_quote: The first bolt hit my shield ward before I'd consciously decided to cast it. That's the thing about Shield — it's a reaction, which means the body decides before the mind does.

subject: contract with Nym Duskryn
fact: The contract with Nym Duskryn stipulated that payment was contingent on Daz surviving, a transactional arrangement he rejected as irrelevant to his commitment to fight.
source_quote: We only get paid if you live... I don't give a damn if you get paid.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym is the corrupted high priestess Ilvara's former house, the reason the party had been prisoners in the first place, and the source of her demonic pact and divine corruption.
source_quote: Ilvara — Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place — folded and went still...

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is the drow house whose elite soldiers were contracted to resolve the crisis in the fungal cavern but failed due to lack of Dispel Magic and poor coordination.
source_quote: The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about this.

subject: Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is the feared mage Daz's former affiliation, and his identity as its feared mage persists even as he stands in the smoke of his own fireball, surrounded by those fighting for him.
source_quote: The feared mage of the Ember Vanguard, standing in the smoke of his own fireball, surrounded by people who were fighting because he refused to leave.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds that purpose feels like refusing to hide, refusing to be extracted, and standing in the smoke of his own fireball while others fight for him, and he is surprised by how true this feels.
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who picked Ilvara up and used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her, hauling her forty feet into the air and dropping her after striking her twice in the ribs during the ascent.
source_quote: He had opened this fight by *picking Ilvara up*. Used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her, hauled her forty feet into the air, hit her twice in the ribs during the ascent, and dropped her.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is described by Zalthir as the one whose face was worn by Zuggtmoy, and who spoke in prophecy about the bride, chaos, and the mayhem to come, with the tone of someone who had already made peace with her fate.
source_quote: Something Zuggtmoy-deep, something that had nothing to do with Ilvara Mizzrym's personal opinion of Zalthir and everything to do with the demon lord wearing her face — *landed*.

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern contains a collapsed bridge, a ruined heart fungus, a poisonous bloom of spores from Ilvara’s detonation, and fungal growth thrown up by Ilvara during the fight.
source_quote: The bridge was rubble. The poisonous bloom was already beginning to thin and drift. She was busy reshaping the battlefield around herself, throwing up fungal growth, buying room she knew she needed.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having teleported across the battlefield using shadow-step and struck the T'sarran mage once, killing him instantly.
source_quote: He teleported across the battlefield — shadow-step, the distance closing in the space between one breath and the next — and hit the mage once, and that was enough. The man went down.

subject: T'sarran mage
fact: The T'sarran mage fired a lightning bolt into the cavern upon arrival, hitting only open air, and was later killed by Zalthir after being previously damaged by Daz's empowered fireball.
source_quote: He had fired a lightning bolt into the cavern when he arrived — a dramatic entrance, the kind with real commitment — and hit nothing. Just open air and ambition. Daz had already run an empowered fireball through him; the man was singed at the edges and blinking with the stunned expression of someone who had entered this fight expecting an easy kill and received instead a detailed education in why that assumption was wrong.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum delivered a Guiding Bolt that struck Ilvara, causing her body to rupture into a massive toxic bloom of poisonous spores, which filled the cavern and forced others to retreat.
source_quote: The bolt left my hand. It lanced across the cavern floor in a concentrated column of radiant light and found her where she stood. She did not die quietly. She detonated. Her body ruptured outward in a massive toxic bloom — a cloud of poisonous spores billowing through the cavern in every direction...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin toppled the bridge, sending Ilvara and Zalthir crashing to the cavern floor, and destroyed the heart fungus in one devastating round with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor... The fungus, at least, was mine. Clean and total. Dawnbringer lit the thing up from the first swing and it never got a second chance.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz fired an empowered fireball that severely damaged the T'sarran mage before Zalthir delivered the killing blow.
source_quote: Daz had already run an empowered fireball through him; the man was singed at the edges and blinking with the stunned expression of someone who had entered this fight expecting an easy kill and received instead a detailed education in why that assumption was wrong.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree dropped to her knees after Ilvara’s detonation and began murmuring prayers to Lolth, reshaping the event into theology for her goddess.
source_quote: Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers, her voice the only sound left — words to Lolth, rising from the wreckage, already reshaping what she'd witnessed into something her goddess could use.

subject: T'sarran warrior
fact: The last T'sarran warrior, after witnessing his mage dead and Ilvara reduced to spores, stepped back toward the tunnels and declared, 'We will meet again. Enjoy your victory for the moment.'
source_quote: The last House T'sarran warrior looked at all of it — his mage dead, his guards incinerated, Ilvara nothing but settling spores and a fading prophecy about a bride — and stepped back toward the tunnels without urgency. 'We will meet again,' he said. 'Enjoy your victory for the moment.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is noted as asking his first real question after the spore cloud thinned: 'about Glabbagool.'
source_quote: My first real question, once the cloud was thin enough to breathe through, was about Glabbagool.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is described as standing in silence after the battle, letting the quiet be quiet, acknowledging victory but uncertain of its cost or consequences.
source_quote: I stood there and let the quiet be quiet. We'd won. I couldn't tell you yet what winning this one cost, or what it opened up ahead of us...

subject: bridge
fact: The bridge was toppled by Thorin and reduced to rubble, causing Ilvara and Zalthir to fall into the cavern below.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor...

subject: heart fungus
fact: The heart fungus was destroyed by Thorin in a single round with Dawnbringer, collapsing into ruin before any other combatant could act.
source_quote: The heart fungus was already a collapsed ruin — Thorin had seen to that in one devastating, almost insulting round...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having the Eldritch Claw Tattoo with fifteen feet of reach, yet choosing not to close the distance to Ilvara despite the reach advantage.
source_quote: He had the Eldritch Claw Tattoo — fifteen feet of reach — but the distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is described as still howling and muttering prophecies about vengeance, Zuggtmoy, and the bride even after her body had been destroyed, her voice ragged with desperation.
source_quote: Ilvara was still on the far side of the cavern, still howling, her voice ragged with the particular desperation of someone who has run out of futures but not yet run out of throat. *Vengeance. Zuggtmoy. The bride.* All of it tumbling out between strikes and retreats.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir internally acknowledges the rule that he should not be near Ilvara, and accepts the fear condition as self-administered discipline, even though it humiliates him.
source_quote: *I am supposed to be trying to not be near her. Right.* Not a question. Just the rule, stated plainly, applied against his own interest the way you check a knot even when you know you tied it correctly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reflects that Bahamut receives credit for the radiance of his Guiding Bolt, while he receives credit for positioning, and that they understand each other.
source_quote: Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning. We understand each other, Bahamut and I.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I'm a monk,' in response to being reminded that his entire contribution to the fight required contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.
source_quote: 'I'm a monk.' This came out in response to someone noting — correctly, irritatingly — that his entire contribution to a fight was predicated on being in contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I do what I can,' after destroying the heart fungus with Dawnbringer, acknowledging the simplicity of his action despite its effectiveness.
source_quote: I said *I do what I can* because what else do you say when you've just ruined someone's evening in two rounds of radiant damage.

subject: tunnels
fact: The T'sarran warrior retreated toward the tunnels after the battle, indicating the conflict was not fully resolved and future encounters are anticipated.
source_quote: and stepped back toward the tunnels without urgency.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir internally notes, '*We barely knew you, man.*' as a silent reflection on the T'sarran mage's death, without speaking it aloud.
source_quote: *We barely knew you, man.* He didn't say this aloud. Just noted it, and turned toward where the remaining work was being done.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notes that a threat delivered without heat is more credible than one made in anger, and resolves to find out who the matron mother of House T'sarran is.
source_quote: A threat delivered without heat is always more credible than one made in anger. I'll want to remember that name. The matron mother of House T'sarran would be hearing about this. I believe I should find out who that is before she finds out who we are.

subject: cavern floor
fact: The cavern floor is described as littered with the body of the T'sarran mage, the remnants of Ilvara’s spore bloom, and the collapsed fungus, with Asha Vandree praying nearby.
source_quote: The mage's body settled on the cavern floor. Behind Zalthir, someone — Grygum, probably — was already moving forward. Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I shall punch the mage.*' without enthusiasm, before teleporting and killing him.
source_quote: *I shall punch the mage.* Zalthir said this without particular enthusiasm.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes that the fear cleared at the end of his turn, as promised, and notes this without celebration.
source_quote: The fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to. He noted this without celebration.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reflects that he had planned extensively for the heart fungus but found himself with nowhere to deploy his preparations when Thorin destroyed it in one round.
source_quote: *Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.*

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin describes himself as having spent most of the battle running, acknowledging that he was not holding the center but simply picking a direction and going.
source_quote: The real version is that I'm a dwarf with a glowing sword in a sprawling cavern fight and at some point you stop pretending you've got angles on all of it and just pick a direction and go.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having delivered the entire fight as a series of surgical moves with the emotional register of someone sorting correspondence.
source_quote: Zalthir had been up and down and around, doing what Zalthir does, the entire fight a series of surgical moves delivered with the emotional register of someone sorting correspondence.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is described as having been corrupted by Zuggtmoy for a long time, and that she was no longer being aided by the demon lord but had become Zuggtmoy's work walking in a drow priestess’s bones.
source_quote: She was not being aided by Zuggtmoy anymore. She *was* Zuggtmoy's work, walking around in a drow priestess's bones.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having hated the frightened condition immediately upon understanding it, because it cannot be argued with.
source_quote: Zalthir understood it immediately — and hated it with the particular hatred reserved for things that cannot be argued with.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is described as being amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama but still choosing to attack them, because Bahamut does not favor spectatorship.
source_quote: I'm amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, I thought. But I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*How do I not be frightened?*' because he wanted to know the timeline — one turn — and needed to wait.
source_quote: 'How do I not be frightened?' He had asked, because he wanted to know the timeline. One turn. He just needed to wait one turn.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*not ideal, how big is the cloud, glad I was standing back.*' as his entire reflection on killing Ilvara.
source_quote: *not ideal, how big is the cloud, glad I was standing back.* That is the whole thought.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.*' as a silent reflection on Grygum's and Zalthir's actions while he destroyed the fungus.
source_quote: *Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.*

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having accepted the condition of fear as self-administered discipline, and not fought it or looked for angles.
source_quote: He didn't fight the condition. He didn't look for angles. The spirit of it was that he shouldn't close on her, and he knew the spirit of it, and so he didn't. The discipline is self-administered. Always has been.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree is described as praying to Lolth in the aftermath, reshaping the event into theology, and Grygum files this under '*watch this space.*'
source_quote: Whatever theology she was building out of this moment, I filed it under *watch this space.*

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as watching Ilvara from across the cavern and being unable to move toward her, filing it away and waiting.
source_quote: He watched from across the cavern and could not move toward her and filed it away and waited.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*Maybe she would be.*' in reference to Asha Vandree’s prayers being answered, acknowledging that he has seen stranger things answered.
source_quote: Maybe she would be. I've seen stranger things answered.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.*' after observing the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, indicating his decision to act despite amusement.
source_quote: I'm amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, I thought. But I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*Yeah. I mean, how do you slap?*' as an internal response to being reminded that his entire contribution required contact with the thing he was supposed to destroy.
source_quote: *Yeah. I mean, how do you slap?* No answer to that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having delivered his actions with the emotional register of someone pushing a chair under a table.
source_quote: He had delivered it with the emotional register of someone pushing a chair under a table.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning.*' as his personal philosophy on divine intervention and tactical execution.
source_quote: Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning. We understand each other, Bahamut and I.

subject: Zalthir
